description: The chart represents the distribution of subtasks in the MMRA benchmark, comparing the proportions of different categories. The pie chart is divided into 11 slices, each labeled with a distinct category name and colored differently. The categories and their corresponding proportions are: NearSameEntity (dark grey, 6.34%), RelativePosition (light grey, 7.90%), MentalitySimilarity (light blue, 8.67%), SimilarEvent (blue, 8.77%), AppearanceSimilarity (yellow, 8.77%), Layout (beige, 8.77%), Environment (teal, 8.77%), UsageSimilarity (burnt orange, 9.65%), SubEvent (red, 9.74%), SimilarMaterial (orange, 10.33%), and ObservationAngle (mint green, 12.28%). The percentages are labeled inside or adjacent to each slice, and there is no legend or visual emphasis on any particular slice. The slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise order, with no apparent ordering by size.
